title: Luis Russell's band at the Nest Club and the Broadway tips
summary: He joined Luis Russell at the Nest Club, working ten to six or seven in the morning for Broadway stars like Helen Morgan and Harry Richman; salary was $84 a week with tips almost as much.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: So then from then -- Then, getting back to New York, one night I went to work with Luis Russell at a place called The Nest Club, and I worked with Luis Russell for a long time.

And we used to go to work around ten o'clock till six, seven o'clock in the morning and we used to stay there and the big shots from Broadway would come in. All those big shots, like the stars, they called themselves, you know, fooling around in the morning and they'd come to the Nest and --
Who were the stars on Broadway then?

What's that girl? Helen Morgan. I can't think of all of them. Harry Richman. All them kind of people, and they called themselves, Browsing through Harlem, you know, and they come there and the boss was asking, "If anybody wants to stay, you can make some money playing for them people." You know, to entertain them.
And they'd come in there and they'd stay sometimes till 12, one o'clock.
The next day, till at noon?

Yeah, till at noon.) So we stayed there until sometime 12, one o'clock, and play for these people. And then I'd make my money -- my salary didn't mean a thing because I'd make more money than my salary. We'd just make more money. Sometimes we'd come out with $70, $80 tips from these people, and just that one night, one day.
What was the salary at that time?
Oh, salary. The salary was about $75, $80 -- No, $84. And we would make all -- that much in one night.

Yeah, $84 a week, but we'd make almost that in tips sometimes. 75, 80. It depends on how they feel, you know. And then I stayed there. Then Charlie Johnson was the -- you see, we were supposed to be Charlie Johnson's second band because he was at Small's Paradise. And he got Luis Russell the job and Luis got the men.
